authority: official SVG rendered by canonical Chromium
reason: The Rotated frame exports a 112.12x83.84 px page because spec 8.6 keeps MediaBox at the unrounded frame bounds, and its official-SVG authority is Chromium's raster of that fractional SVG drawn into its rounded 112x84 natural size, so the authority's bottom row is a rescaled partial row with alpha 160 that no exact-scale render reproduces. PDF.js at exact 96/72 scale on the 112x84 canvas covers 0.84 of that row and Skia's supersampled coverage gives alpha 191; rows 0-82 are identical. The 112 changed pixels are exactly that row, 1.19% against the 1% mixed budget. Diagnosed on #119.
